guarantees.claim: When hmac_fifo_wsel is true and digest_size equals SHA2_256, fifo_wdata is assigned '{data: digest[hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[2:0]][31:0], mask: '1} and index remains 1'b0.
When hmac_fifo_wsel is true and digest_size equals SHA2_384 or SHA2_512, fifo_wdata is assigned '{data: digest[hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[3:1]][32*index+:32], mask: '1} with index = !hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[0].
When hmac_fifo_wsel is true and digest_size is not SHA2_256, SHA2_384, or SHA2_512, fifo_wdata is driven to all zeros (data=0, mask=0) and index remains 1'b0.
guarantees.cond: hmac_fifo_wsel == 1 && (digest_size != SHA2_256 && digest_size != SHA2_384 && digest_size != SHA2_512)

guarantees.claim: When hmac_fifo_wsel is false, fifo_wdata is assigned reg_fifo_wentry and index is 1'b0.

assumptions.claim: hmac_fifo_wdata_sel bit-fields are bounded so that the word indices (hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[2:0] for SHA2_256, hmac_fifo_wdata_sel[3:1] for SHA2_384/SHA2_512) remain within the digest array dimensions for the selected mode.
assumptions.cond: always when this block is active
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds memory access on digest array, potentially reading unpredictable data or causing simulation/synthesis errors.

assumptions.claim: digest array entries are at least 64 bits wide for digest_size SHA2_384/SHA2_512 and at least 32 bits wide for SHA2_256, so the part-selects [31:0] and [32*index+:32] are legal.
assumptions.risk: Compile or simulation error due to out-of-range part-select.

assumptions.claim: This always_comb block is instantiated only when hmac_fifo_wsel is true, so the false branch (default) is unreachable and does not drive real hardware; otherwise, conflicting writes to fifo_wdata may occur.
assumptions.risk: If block is incorrectly instantiated with hmac_fifo_wsel false, it would drive reg_fifo_wentry to fifo_wdata, conflicting with other drivers.

uncertain_points.claim: If digest_size can take a legal value other than SHA2_256, SHA2_384, SHA2_512 while hmac_fifo_wsel is true, the block outputs zero data with mask=0, potentially feeding zeroized digest words to the FIFO and causing incorrect HMAC output or deadlock.
uncertain_points.cond: digest_size not in {SHA2_256, SHA2_384, SHA2_512} and hmac_fifo_wsel true
uncertain_points.risk: Silent data corruption or security bypass in HMAC operation.

uncertain_points.claim: The design relies on external logic to sequence hmac_fifo_wdata_sel correctly; a control error could provide an index larger than the digest array, leading to out-of-bounds reads.
uncertain_points.cond: hmac_fifo_wdata_sel exceeds digest word count for current mode
uncertain_points.risk: Unpredictable data put into FIFO, potentially corrupting HMAC result.

uncertain_points.claim: The mask signal is always set to '1 when writing digest chunks, but code comment implies zero padding is discarded for SHA2_256; for SHA2_384/SHA2_512, the sequence of upper/lower 32-bit reads still uses full mask, which is expected but no explicit rationale for partial mask usage exists.
uncertain_points.risk: If future SHA mode introduces non-multiple-of-32-bit digest length, mask could be incorrect, causing data corruption.
